data.source_title: Protocol for the handover of ambulance patients in the Emergency Department process map
data.locator: Process map: clinical handover process, triage, registration, ED treatment location and data capture points.
data.source_setting: Victorian Department of Health ambulance-to-ED handover process guidance.
data.source_n: Not applicable; official process map, not a cohort.
data.value: After arrival and clinical handover, ED location is immediately available as treatment space or waiting room depending on patient condition and acuity; if no ED location is available, patient remains on ambulance stretcher with regular triage-nurse review. Process map separately records triage and registration.
data.source_evidence_basis: Inspected the original one-page PDF: it explicitly shows pre-arrival review, IMIST-AMBO handover, triage and registration, transfer to a treatment space/chair/waiting room when location is available, or ambulance-stretcher hold with regular triage-nurse review plus escalation arrangements when no location is available within local thresholds. It defines the handover-complete timestamp after agreement, clinician acceptance of responsibility and related tasks.
data.limitations: A stated process design, not measured compliance, frequency, or elapsed-time distribution; Australian workflow may not match RWJ.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Add distinct EMS stretcher-hold, repeat nurse review, registration, and placement transitions. Do not infer how often the hold occurs or its duration.
